info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Parking Reservations Pricings-v5-spec
info.description: The List Parking Reservation Pricing API provides a comprehensive view of the pricing structures for parking reservations. Designed for businesses in the transportation and hospitality sectors, this API enables users to retrieve detailed pricing information based on various reservation parameters. Typical consumers include developers creating applications for parking management, travel agencies, and event organizers who need up-to-date pricing data. By utilizing this API, stakeholders can enhance their services and optimize pricing strategies based on demand and availability.

get.summary: Retrieve the current pricing for reservations.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the latest pricing information for reservations. It provides details on the cost associated with different reservation options available in the system.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving the pricing information related to reservations. This should contain criteria specifying the details of the reservation for which pricing is being requested.

200.description: Successfully retrieved pricing information for reservations.
